articles.title: Defence Ministry may clear major indigenous defence projects today including integrated air defence weapon system
articles.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), the Defence Ministry's top procurement body, is set to meet today to approve significant indigenous projects for the Indian defence forces. This move aims to bolster India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing, clearing major homegrown equipment, including an integrated air defence system. Such initiatives are crucial for modernizing our armed forces and strengthening national security.

articles.title: IRCTC ticket fare hike 2025 from today: List of trains, distance slabs and classes with revised ticket prices
articles.summary: Indian Railways has revised passenger fares, aiming to balance affordability for travellers with the long-term sustainability of railway operations. This strategic move is crucial for bolstering the national transporter's financial health, enabling modernization and infrastructure development. Such initiatives are vital for enhancing national connectivity, supporting economic growth, and maintaining efficient public transport systems, impacting India's logistical capabilities and overall internal security.

articles.title: Can the Gaza ceasefire hold? Trump’s peace plan enters its most perilous stage
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump hopes to announce an early next-year commencement for the second phase of the Gaza ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas. Despite acknowledging significant obstacles and unresolved questions, the administration aims for progress in stabilizing the region. This move is crucial for fostering peace and security in the Middle East, requiring sustained diplomatic efforts.
